title: Amalgamated Holdings Limited - completed acquisition of leasehold interests and other assets related to cinemas located in Cronulla and Beverly Hills, NSW
targets: Certain cinema assets of D&G Cinemas Pty Limited

timeline.event: Amalgamated Holdings Limited acquired leasehold interests and other assets related to cinemas located in Cronulla and Beverly Hills, NSW.
ACCC commenced a public review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.

The ACCC announced that, based on the information available at this time, it would discontinue its investigation into the completed acquisition. The ACCC will however continue to monitor the effect of the acquisition on competition in the relevant markets.
